subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘hinderance’ in the given sentence and choose the correct option.

The refreshing breeze blew through the open window, bringing relief from the summer heat.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**hindrance**'(बाधा) refers to something that provides resistance, delay, or obstruction to something or someone.

 
 
• **Example:** Heavy traffic can be a major hindrance to emergency vehicles trying to reach an accident scene.
 
 
 
• The antonym selected, '**Relief**',(राहत) implies a feeling of reassurance and relaxation following worry, pain, or distress.
 
 
• **Example:** After the medication, the patient felt immediate relief from pain.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer **is **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bringing(**लाना): This word means to carry someone or something to a place.

 
 
• **Example**: He is bringing his friends to the party tonight.
 
 
 
• **Blew(**उड़ाना): This verb refers to the action of wind moving or causing something to move.
 
 
• **Example**: The strong wind blew the hat off his head.
 
 
 
• **Refreshing(**ताज़गी): This adjective describes something that is pleasantly fresh and different. 
 
 
• **Example**: A refreshing drink is all I need after a long day at work.
